description: All experiment scripts, their purpose, results, and current status.

configNotes.universe: 35 NSE large-cap stocks, 8 sectors — M&M.NS replaces TATAMOTORS.NS
configNotes.wfvFolds: Fold 1: Train 2016-2019 / Test 2020 ... Fold 6: Train 2016-2024 / Test 2025 (expanding)

E1.name: Frequency Comparison
E1.purpose: Justify daily data choice empirically over hourly.
E1.status: PARTIAL — stat_only mode done; full-mode run not yet done (lower priority, after E7)

keyResults.conclusion: Daily confirmed as the right frequency; hourly selects poor pairs and goes bankrupt after costs.

E2.name: Signal Hold Period Sweep
E2.purpose: Find optimal minimum holding period to reduce over-trading and cost drag.

E3.name: Performance Attribution / Ablation
E3.purpose: Measure the contribution of each selector (Stage 1) and each signal model (Stage 2). Prove or disprove ensemble benefit.

full.verdict: Equal-weight ensemble underperforms best individual in both modes.

E4.name: Walk-Forward Validation
E4.purpose: Replace single in-sample backtest with rolling OOS evaluation (academic standard).

keyResults.HEADLINE: stat_only + ou_only: Full-OOS Net SR +0.359 (Gross 0.627), 87 trades/yr, 1.95pp cost drag, 67% folds positive

stat_ml_ou_only.note: MLSelector HURTS even with label bug fixed

full_ou_only.note: DL selectors degrade OOS under equal-weight

E5.name: Benchmark Comparison
E5.purpose: Compare strategy net returns against Indian indices.
E5.status: COMPLETE (on headline E4 result). Re-run on E7 result pending.

keyResults.conclusion: Near-zero beta, positive alpha, significantly lower drawdown than benchmarks.

E6.name: Statistical Significance
E6.purpose: Confirm performance differences are not due to chance. Bootstrap CI + Bonferroni.
E6.status: COMPLETE (on headline E4 result). Re-run on full-mode + E7 results pending.

keyResults.academicConclusion: Gross alpha is real (p=0.038); net alpha below detection threshold given 6yr OOS sample — honest finding.

E7.name: Weighted Ensemble WFV
E7.purpose: Test whether optimal S1 weighting (LSTM-heavy) recovers ensemble benefit vs best individual (LSTM_only +0.305).
E7.target: Beat LSTM_only Net SR +0.305 on full-OOS — ACHIEVED (+0.780)

E8.name: RL Signal Model
E8.purpose: Novel contribution — PPO-based RL agent as Stage 2 signal model for NSE pairs trading.

keyResults.conclusion: RL (PPO) underperforms the OUThreshold baseline (+0.780). Mean-reversion priors in OU are more effective than model-free PPO for spread trading.

E8.design: state=11-feature spread vector, action={-1,0,+1}, reward=net PnL after costs, agent=PPO (stable-baselines3)
